name: Paul Gerste
biography: Paul Gerste is a vulnerability researcher on Sonar's R&D team. He has a proven talent for finding security issues, demonstrated by his two successful Pwn2Own participations and discoveries in popular applications like Proton Mail, Visual Studio Code, and Rocket.Chat. When Paul is not at work, he enjoys playing CTFs with team FluxFingers and organizing Hack.lu CTF.
